accepted: R8 adds a validated required_mode option to the held nofollow reader and applies exact 0400 mode to the fixed native attempt selector before bytes are read; file_key rechecks st_mode after reading.
The selector read is capped at 4096 bytes before and during the held read, and the reader rejects nested duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity constants, and exponent-overflow floats before schema checks.

The current native launch context and parent pins have exact three-field types and bounds, and the four-field selector is joined to those current pins and validated against separately read fixed result paths.

Stage2 and native reporting remain independent, and missing launch files use launch_or_binding_absent. Metadata remains bounded diagnostic reporting; PBS is observed with lstat and is not executed or admitted.
Original wall, self-RSS, aggregate input, report, held-file, and retained-output controls are unchanged from R7.

nonblocking_observations.finding: Some error summaries emit the exception class name directly rather than mapping every path through SAFE_ERROR_TYPES. The emitted field contains no exception message or input body, and all source-controlled failure paths reviewed use bounded exception classes; this remains a label-closure observation, not a blocker to the R8 mode fix.

coverage: Static review of the complete R8 source, verified R7-to-R8 delta, selector contract and producer mode behavior, prior R7 review, and Stage1 native launch writer. No actual launch, selector, attempt receipt, runtime/private tree, or CI/native output was read.
qualification: Source-only review. No import, compilation, fixture, test, helper, process, network, CI, native action, owner admission, or actual runtime evidence verification.
limitations: This accepts the source contract only; actual selector and launch records were not read.
No current Stage1 whole-bundle, CI, native, owner, relay, artifact-authentication, or producer-runtime qualification is inferred.
